Zq.bar_b_note: Side B's dark-furred badger with a green shell carapace reads as a coherent naturalistic creature, but on a flat grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade nothing yet matches Palworld/Valheim finish.

Jp.bar_b_note: Side A's smooth clay-toy piglet with moss patches is off the naturalistic style bar, and side B's noisy gold-spotted boar floats in faint mid; both stand only about trainer height.

Ji.bar_b_note: The elder villager has a warm, readable face, a clear silhouette and a green-brown palette that fits the key art, but the close-ups are lit flat on black with no rim light, so the presentation stops short of shipping finish.

Bo.bar_b_note: Side A's large gold ingredient lines and full recipe text read on a blue-grey panel, but the hints are plain keyboard glyphs with no teal accent, the world behind is a murky flat night, and side B truncates recipes and shrinks the hints to tiny grey text.

Pi.bar_b_note: The white-fleeced, black-horned ram matches the owner's Stormcapra bar when standing, but side B's faint mid and faint end twist into a splayed, half-airborne ragdoll, and on both sides the standing frame has lost its label and stage framing.

Ab.bar_b_note: This set looks the same as Zq. Side B's shelled badger carries the identity, while side A's tan canine with a strapped-on cluster of plates does not, and the neutral stage gives no atmosphere to match Palworld or Valheim.

top_changes.change: Bring the off-bar creatures up to the owner's naturalistic style bar: replace the clay-toy piglet (Jp A) and the canine with strapped-on plates (Zq/Ab A) with naturalistic fur-and-plate meshes, and scale them so every creature clearly stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer.

Fix the faint poses so they stay grounded and intact: no airborne or splayed ragdoll (Pi B faint mid/end), no body lifted off its shadow (Jp B faint mid), and legs and horns kept visible (Pi A faint mid). Also restore the stage framing and label on the standing frame (Pi).
Build the craft panel on side A's type scale (untruncated recipe lines, gold ingredient counts), and make the Craft and Leave hints controller glyphs in teal/cyan at title weight.
